dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Darren has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. During his medical exam he was observed to pancake while on the scale. When handlers attempt to interact, Darren has been noted to walk with a lowered body and retreat quickly back to kennel. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Darren
